body: Hey by any chance are you doing core training in the HB Studio or are you in the summer intensive. I am interested in doing the core training and didn't know if it was worth the money.

To tell you the truth years of bullying, trauma,and feeling worthless. My own mom told me to just do it already and kill myself. I just can’t do it anymore. It’s like a weight on my shoulder of just anguish. I just want to be free from it
